description.en: Linked Open Data about Chile and the political environment of the country. Some important graphs published are: Legislative norms, International treaties (linking countries to dbpedia and geonames), geographical data and parliamentary biographies, and we are publishing every day more.

other_download.title: Legislative Norms
other_download.description: The documentation about how to consume legislative norms published as linked open data. That includes URI formats, rdf of example and content types of the published resources.
